name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Address: 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester, near LAX). Open since 1952.
Happy hour is 3-6 PM daily.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 tacos (every taco) and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3.
Joining Melody Rewards is free. You get +100 points when you join.
You earn 10 points per $1 spent on eligible purchases, before tip.
Rewards: 250 pts = free soft drink or Melody Fries; 500 = free starter; 1,000 = $10 off your check; 1,500 = free entree (any Mac & Cheese or burrito).
One reward per visit and one prize per day. Rewards don't stack and have no cash value. Never free alcohol.
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it.
Birthday bonus: +250 points once a year. Referral bonus: +100 per friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
Location bonus: +100 points once, after location and notifications were on for at least 3 different days spanning at least 7 days.
Melody Approach is a free flying game with Campaign and Survival modes. Weekly boards reset every Monday.
Game prizes and game points are in BETA and currently off. The boards are for bragging rights.
When game rewards turn on: 1 point per 100 score, at most 50 game points a day.
Games Pack points: up to 10 a day, and they count toward the 50-a-day game limit.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order today with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
Pick bar, patio, to go, or enter your table number to order from your phone. Pay your server or bartender as usual.
No download needed. The app opens in your phone's browser and can be added to your Home Screen.
The app comes in 12 languages.
Free parking is available. LAX is about a 15-minute walk.
Melody and Nalu Vida (Venice Pier) have separate points balances.
LAX Crew discount: 10% off with a work badge, dine-in only.
suggested: What can I get with my points?
How do I play Melody Approach?

qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester near LAX. The app has a Directions button.
Call (310) 670-1994. The app also has a Call button.
The restaurant's website lists Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late at night.
The website lists a 1:30 AM close, but hours can vary. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.

qa.q: What time does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen's closing time. Please call (310) 670-1994 or ask staff.
Yes, free parking is available, including a free lot for people picking up travelers. Street parking is also an option.
Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. Melody is about 5 minutes away by car.
Yes. Melody is known as the closest bar to LAX, about 5 minutes away.
Tap the Directions button in the app's Visit Melody section. The address is 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd.
I don't have a booking page. Please call (310) 670-1994 to ask about reservations.
Happy hour is 3-6 PM daily, and it includes weekends.

qa.q: What are the happy hour deals?
qa.a: The app lists happy hour as 3-6 daily. The restaurant's website also lists $8 well drinks and $1 off drafts. Ask your server for today's full list.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 tacos (every taco) and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3. Happy hour is 3-6 daily.
Half off burgers, 11 to 3.
Every taco on the menu is $4, and margaritas are $6.

qa.q: How much are margaritas on Tuesday?
qa.a: $6 on Tuesdays.

The restaurant's website lists a Happy Hour Lunch from 11 to 3 with the happy hour food menu only (no drink specials), plus karaoke at night. The app doesn't list a Wednesday special, so ask staff to confirm.
Half off sandwiches, 11 to 3.
$3 sliders, 11 to 3.
The restaurant's website lists weekend brunch Sat and Sun, 9 AM to 3 PM. I don't have the brunch menu in this app, so ask staff.
Every week there's karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia, and every game on the TVs. Ask staff which night is which.
The restaurant's website lists karaoke on Wednesday nights starting around 10 PM. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.
Yes, every game is on the TVs. The app also has an LA Scoreboard with live scores for LA and California teams.
The restaurant's website says most events, including game watch parties and happy hour, have no cover. I don't have cover info for late DJ nights, so ask staff.
The app menu has Starters, Mac & Cheese, Burgers, Fries, Soups, and Tacos & Burritos, plus a Drinks list. Tap Menu in the app to browse.

Lemon Pepper Wings ($16), Avocado Toast ($13), BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites ($15), Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries ($16), Chicken Pot Stickers ($15), Fried Green Beans ($13), Fried Shrimp ($18.25), Jalapeno Calamari ($16), Lettuce Wraps ($16), and Baby Back Ribs & Fries ($20.25).

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese do you have?
qa.a: House Mac $15, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno $17.25, Parmesan & Mushroom $17.25, Chicken Parmesan $18.25, Melody Burger Mac $19.25, and Lobster Mac $21.50. All are fusilli in a creamy cheese blend, baked to order.
The Melody Burger ($19.25) is Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries.

Gilroy Garlic Fries $6.75, Melody Fries $5.75, Onion Strings $9.75, Phat Fries $7.75, Philly Cheese Steak Fries $17.25, and Sweet Potato Fries $7.75. You can add cheese to Melody Fries or Phat Fries for $2.
French Onion, Tomato Bisque, and Black Bean, each as a cup or a bowl. The cup is $9.75-$11 and the bowl is $14-$15.

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos (2 per order): Shrimp, Salmon, Carnitas, Chicken, Avocado, and Beyond. There are also Nachos, a Cheese Quesadilla, and burritos: Carnitas, Steak, Chicken, and Bean & Cheese.
Tacos run $13-$16 per 2-taco order. On Tuesdays every taco is $4.

qa.q: Do you have vegan or vegetarian options?
qa.a: The app menu has Avocado Toast, Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos, Fried Green Beans and Bean & Cheese Burrito. Ask your server about ingredients.

The app lists Mango, House and Paloma drinks, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, draft beer, Mimosa, shots, and a bucket of 5 beers. Drink prices in the app are previews.
Drink prices in the app are previews and not final. Ask your server for current prices.

qa.q: How do I order from my phone?
qa.a: Pick where you're sitting: bar, patio, to go, or your table number. Add items, tap Review order, then Send my order. Pay your server or bartender like normal.

qa.q: What if I scanned a table QR code?
qa.a: Your table is already picked, so just add items and send your order.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: No. You pay your server or bartender like normal, and you still earn points on every check.
Choose To go in the seat picker and send your order. The app says you'll get a text when it's ready.
The restaurant's website lists DoorDash for delivery, and takeout is available.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap to join in the app. It's free and takes about 10 seconds. You earn points on every check and from games, and get a gold rewards card on your phone.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No, joining is free. It's one account per person.

qa.q: Do I get a bonus for joining?
qa.a: Yes, +100 points once when you join.

qa.q: How do I get the app?
qa.a: There's nothing to download. It opens in your phone's browser. Use the link in the Instagram @melodylax bio or scan the table QR code, then add it to your Home Screen if you like.

qa.q: How many points do I earn per dollar?
qa.a: You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app and snap your receipt, or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). It's one receipt per day, each check counts once, and up to $150 per check counts.

qa.q: Is there a limit on claiming visits?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check only once, and up to $150 per check. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales report.

qa.q: Do tip, tax or other things earn points?
qa.a: Points are 10 per $1 on eligible purchases before tip. I don't have a list of what isn't eligible, so ask staff.

qa.q: What can I get with my points?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,000 pts: $10 off your check. 1,500 pts: free entree (any Mac & Cheese or burrito).

qa.q: How many points for a free soft drink or fries?
qa.a: 250 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free starter?
qa.a: 500 points, for Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.
1,000 points for $10 off your check.

qa.q: How many points for a free entree?
qa.a: 1,500 points for any Mac & Cheese or burrito.

qa.q: How do I use a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: It works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. A used or expired code never works again.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward per visit?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit, one prize per day, and rewards don't stack.

qa.q: Can I get a free drink or alcohol with points?
qa.a: The rewards are a soft drink, fries, starters, $10 off and an entree. Rewards never include free alcohol.
The rules say points you earn stay in your balance unless the program ends, but they don't give an expiry rule. Ask staff for details.

qa.q: Can I transfer or cash out rewards?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do points work at Nalu Vida?
qa.a: No. Each spot has its own balance, and Melody points don't move to Nalu Vida.
I don't see member levels in the app. You earn points and cash them in for the four rewards.
Yes, +250 points once a year on your birthday.
Give a friend your code. You get +100 points when they join with it and make a first visit. They enter one friend's code once when they join, and can't use their own.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for turning on location?
qa.a: Yes, +100 points once, when location and notifications were both on when you opened the app on at least 3 different days spanning at least 7 days. It's added automatically.

qa.q: Do you have an early-bird or founding-member gift?
qa.a: The rules mention an early-bird or founding-member gift, but I don't have details. Ask staff.
If you landed at LAX in the last 24 hours, show your boarding pass to your server for 10% off your first order today. It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: Is there a discount for LAX workers?
qa.a: The restaurant's website lists 10% off the whole check for airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car and shuttle workers with a badge. It's dine-in only and can't be combined with other promos.
My Rewards Card shows your card ID, points, next reward, a QR code, and this visit's one-time code. Apple and Google Wallet buttons aren't active yet.
It's a free arcade flying game in the app. You fly a plane over LA, shoot jets and UFOs, dodge fire and catch Melody's food. It has Campaign and Survival modes.

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the boost button for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

It's 10 levels of about 45 seconds each over a real SoCal route, from Melody to Inglewood, the 105, LAX, Venice, Compton, Long Beach and Hollywood. Each level gets harder, there are six boss fights, and you land back at LAX.
There's no finish line. The game keeps getting harder until your plane goes down, and your time survived counts.

qa.q: How does health and damage work?
qa.a: Three hits and your plane goes down, and the game is over. Every enemy attack is warned first, so you can dodge.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses, or flying longer in Survival, unlocks stronger guns. They use limited ammo, refilled by catching ammo crates.
Yes. Tap the crossed-swords button, or use Pause, to switch to a calm flight with no combat.
Shooting enemies and bosses and catching Melody's food and music notes earns score. Campaign boards rank by score, and Survival boards rank by longest time survived.

qa.q: How often can I play the game?
qa.a: It's free to play as often as you like, with or without an account. No purchase is necessary.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two weekly boards, Campaign (by score) and Survival (by longest time). Both reset every Monday. To enter, tap Post my score after a flight. Practice and test flights don't count.

Prizes are in BETA and currently off, so the boards are for bragging rights. Once they switch on, the top player on each board may win the weekly prize shown in the game (for example, free Melody Fries).

qa.q: When are the weekly winners picked?
qa.a: I don't have that detail. The boards reset every Monday. Ask staff how winners are chosen and contacted.

qa.q: Do I earn points from the flying game?
qa.a: Not yet. Game rewards are off during BETA. Once on, you get 1 point per 100 score, at most 50 game points a day.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts on the boards?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.
Trivia, Sports Trivia, Truth or Dare, the daily Melody Word, Melody Mix (word scramble), and the LA Scoreboard. Play solo or pass the phone around the table.
Pick a category (music, food and drink, pop culture, LA, or everything), then play solo (10 questions) or pass the phone with 2-6 players. Faster right answers score more.
Pick your team for a 10-question Fan Test and get a Fan Rating, or play all LA sports. You can play solo or pass the phone with 2-6 players.
It's a daily 5-letter word game, the same for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints. A new word comes every day at midnight LA time.
It's a word scramble. Unscramble as many words as you can before time runs out, with 3 skips.
It's a table game for 1-6 players with light truths and fun dares. It's just for fun and gives no points. Dares never involve drinking, and anyone can pass.

qa.q: Do the trivia and word games give points?
qa.a: Not yet, because game rewards are in BETA. Once on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (up to 3), and the daily Melody Word 3 points (2 with 1 hint, 1 with 2 hints). The cap is 10 Games Pack points a day.
It shows live scores from ESPN for LA and California teams, with where to watch. It's for information only and has no streams.

qa.q: What are the Who wins picks?
qa.a: They're free, fun picks with no money or wagers. Picks lock when the game starts. Once game rewards are on, a right pick earns 2 points, at most 6 a day.

It's a free game for NFL and college games. Each member gets 1 free square per board, and extra squares come with purchases. Prizes are food, merch or discounts, never cash or free alcohol. Ask staff when a board is open.

qa.q: Which languages does the app support?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages. Look for the language option in the app.
I don't have details on kid mode rules. Some adult-only games may be hidden in it. Ask staff.
The restaurant's website says it's family-friendly by day and hosts kids' birthday parties. I don't have the evening age policy, so call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Can I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Yes. Add it from your phone browser's share or menu options. On iPhone, notifications need the app on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer).

qa.q: What does Turn on nearby alerts do?
qa.a: It's optional. It asks your phone for location and notification permission so the app can show a You're nearby deal when you open it within about half a mile of Melody. It works only while the app is open.

qa.q: What do you collect about me?
qa.a: If you turn on nearby alerts, the app records that location and notifications were on, plus an approximate location (about 1 km) when you open the app. Each app open also logs the time, a device summary, a random phone ID and your member ID. Your exact location stays on your phone. It's never sold or used for ads.

qa.q: How do I turn off location?
qa.a: Tap Turn off nearby alerts in the app, or switch off Location and Notifications for the app in your phone's Settings. Points you earned stay.

qa.q: Do you host private events or catering?
qa.a: The restaurant's website lists private events for 10-150 guests, including a private party room with a pool table, and catering. Call (310) 670-1994.
Free Wi-Fi is listed by TripAdvisor, but I can't confirm it. Ask staff.
TripAdvisor lists it as wheelchair accessible. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: What payment cards do you take?
qa.a: TripAdvisor lists AmEx, Discover, Mastercard and Visa. Ask staff if you need another option.
It's Melody's sister spot at the Venice Pier. The app has a link to ride over to it. It has its own separate points balance.
I don't have a dress code. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
I don't have that detail. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
Yes. The app features a Los Angeles Times story dated Oct. 21, 2026, by Daniel Hernandez. Tap the story link on the app's home page to read it.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.
